purpose: Controlled mechanism, solver, ranking-exponent, Top-K, renewal, and fixed-baseline comparisons without retraining.
replication_unit: proposal-initialization inference seed on one fixed trained checkpoint
aggregation: arithmetic mean of independently evaluated COCO metrics
strict_boundary: These means measure stochastic proposal-initialization variation conditional on a checkpoint. They must not be described as training-seed replication or combined with independently trained means to estimate between-training uncertainty.
